name: Kyonyuu Hitozuma Netorare Saimin ~Share House de Kanrinin to Tsuma ga…… ~
original_name: 巨乳人妻寝取られ催眠 ～シェアハウスで管理人と妻が…… ～
source:
I’m Keiichi Takagaki, a civil servant, and I just got married.
This time, my new wife, Orina, and I decided to move into a shared house called Suika no Basha (Watermelon Carriage).
The rent was cheap, but more importantly, the place had a reputation as a “fertility mansion”—couples who moved in often ended up having children.

The people we’d be sharing the house with were the slightly older Shibungi couple.
By the way, the wife, Sari, was a stunningly beautiful woman with an alluring charm.

Then there was the owner of the shared house, You Sawatari.
He was managing Suika no Basha, a property he inherited from his parents.
Despite his youth, he was a reliable and diligent young man, deeply engrossed in his hobby of studying “hypnotism.” My wife seemed to like him, and having such an owner around felt reassuring.
Yes, absolutely reassuring. Nothing strange would happen here.
Sari sucking the owner’s genitals? Orina moaning the owner’s name while masturbating?
All of it, all of it was perfectly normal…

Today, like every day, I threw myself into my work.
For the sake of my beloved wife and the child we’d hopefully have someday…

translation:
我叫高垣圭一，是一名公务员，刚刚结婚。
这次，我与新婚妻子织奈决定搬进一栋名叫“西瓜马车”的合租住宅。
租金便宜固然是原因之一，但更重要的是，这里据说是一栋“送子公寓”——搬进来的夫妻，往往很快就会有孩子。

与我们共同生活的，是比我们稍年长一些的四分仪夫妇。
顺带一提，妻子纱璃是一位风情万种、十分出众的美女。

还有这栋合租住宅的房东冴渡夭。
他亲自管理着从父母那里继承来的“西瓜马车”。
虽然年轻，却是个可靠、踏实的好青年，每天都认真钻研自己的爱好——“催眠术”。妻子似乎也很喜欢他，有这样的房东在，实在让人放心。
没错，绝对可以放心。这里不会发生任何奇怪的事。
纱璃含吮房东的生殖器？织奈一边呻吟着喊房东的名字，一边自慰？
这一切，这一切都再正常不过…

今天，我也像往常一样，全心投入工作。
为了心爱的妻子，也为了我们期盼着将来能拥有的孩子…
